info.title: Daily Ops Last Mile Dashboard
info.description: Live nationwide operations dashboard for Ninja Van Malaysia's last-mile fleet team (143 stations across Southern, Northern, Klang Valley, East Coast and East Malaysia -- East Malaysia is Retail, not Last Mile, so it can be toggled out of every view). Pulls parcel- and route-level data from Redash every 15 minutes and shows it per region, zone, station and driver: Action Board (SLA heatmap), Shipment Details (fresh unscan, latlong, scan-in duration buckets and an hourly timing chart), Station Health (in-hub, 0-attempt, on-hold, aging, missing, pending ATS, COD%), Route Monitoring (routed, attendance, OVFD, success and completion rates by driver type, old routes, pending-in-yesterday-route, completion summary), Aging Details, RPU, Recovery (missing parcels), Shipper Radar (Zalora, Amway, Watson, Orca, Sodaxpress SLAs; Restock NXD bundles, on-hold / incomplete MPS bundles; B2B RDO document compliance), Cold Chain and Urgent TN (track tracking numbers and assign them to a PIC with in-progress / closed status and notifications), DoD (Station Health day by day), a Task List (follow-ups, to-dos, assigned tasks) and a KPI page (Beta) with the weekly results, the OPEX result and RCA / analysis for Hybrid Productivity, Invalid POD, COD RTS, Prior, Completion D0 / D3, Terminal T7 and FIFO D0, judged against KPI targets per region that an admin sets. Every count opens its tracking numbers, with CSV export. Access is role-based (admin, manager, region, station) with multi-value region/zone/station scopes enforced in the backend; an admin can preview any role or user with the Role Tester. Users can send feedback (with an attachment) that admins reply to and close. For Fleet Managers and their regional and station teams. Every /api route answers for the signed-in user (Google SSO: the platform adds X-Forwarded-Email) and is limited to that user's role and region / zone / station scope.

post.summary: Ask to correct a PTWH's clock record (edit the times, fill a missing day, or void it) with a reason; max 12 h per shift; a change within 30 minutes of the original applies at once and is logged, anything else waits for approval and holds that day's pay.
post.description: Ask to change (or void) one day's clock record. Small changes to a station-keyed record are applied at once and logged; the rest wait for approval.

get.summary: Corrections for the caller's stations (this month and last), filtered by status, with whether the caller may decide each one.
get.description: Correction requests and their history for the stations in the caller's scope (this month and last by default).

post.summary: Approve or reject a waiting correction (Region Head, RFS, HOD or Manager; never the person who asked, except the Superadmin); an approval applies the change, a rejection needs a note.
post.description: A Region Head / RFS / Manager / HOD (or the Superadmin -- never the person who asked) approves or rejects a correction. Approving applies it.

get.summary: Attendance -> Staff: the signed-in Station Head / Fleet Assistant's own clock -- whether they can clock, their station(s), today's record and scheduled shift.
get.description: The signed-in person's own clock: whether they can clock here, their station, today's record and today's scheduled shift.

post.summary: Clock the signed-in Station Head / Fleet Assistant in or out; needs the phone's location within 100 m of their station's Premises latitude / longitude; the server takes the time.
post.description: Clock the signed-in person in or out. Needs the phone within 100 m of their station; the server takes the time.

get.summary: Every Station Head / Fleet Assistant in the caller's scope with that day's scheduled shift and clock in / out (today by default).
get.description: Who in the caller's scope has clocked in on a day (today by default), with the scheduled shift.

get.summary: The staff month grid: a row per Station Head / Fleet Assistant in scope with hours per day, days worked and days still open.
get.description: The month grid: a row per Station Head / Fleet Assistant in scope with hours per day, days worked and days still open (no clock-out).

post.summary: Region Head / RFS / HOD / Manager sets a staff member's clock times for a day with a reason (max 12 h, originals kept, never your own).
post.description: Set a Station Head's / Fleet Assistant's clock times for a day (forgotten clock-out, wrong time, a day they couldn't clock). Keeps the originals and who / why.

get.summary: Attendance -> PTWH (staging): the PTWH roster for the stations in the caller's scope (IC masked except for managers / admins), the stations they may use, and whether they may edit.

post.summary: Add a PTWH (name, station, IC, phone, daily rate, joined date) to a station in the caller's scope; station / region staff, managers and admins only.
Approve or reject a NEW PTWH hire: the Region Head decides first, then a Manager / HOD (the Superadmin may do either). The final approval makes the worker active; a rejection needs a note.
post.description: The Region Head (step 1) or a Manager / HOD (step 2) approves or rejects a new PTWH hire (or a re-hire). The final approval makes the worker active.

post.summary: Bring back an ended or inactive PTWH (at the same or another station): needs the same Region Head then Manager approval as a new hire; clears the end date.
post.description: Bring an inactive PTWH back. Same as a new hire: the Region Head, then a Manager, must approve before they can clock in again.

patch.summary: Edit a PTWH or deactivate them (active=false); their history is kept. A masked IC in the body means 'unchanged'.

post.summary: Import the PTWH DETAILS tab (CSV upload): adds only people not already in the list, for stations in the caller's scope, never overwrites. dry_run=true (default) only reports what would be added.
post.description:
Roster import from the PTWH DETAILS tab downloaded as CSV (File -> Download -> .csv). Matches columns by header (Full Name, IC No, Station,
Phone No, Joined Date, Rate; an optional Category or Justification column fills the default category). Only people NOT already in the list are
added -- nobody is overwritten, so a station's later edits survive a re-import -- and only for stations in the caller's scope. With dry_run
(the default) nothing is written: it just says what would happen, so the screen can show it before the person confirms.

get.summary: Every active PTWH in scope with that day's clock in / out, hours, category and source (today by default), plus the 4 categories and the half-day pay rule.
get.description: Every PTWH in scope who can work today (or who has a record that day) with that day's clock times (today by default).

post.summary: Clock a PTWH in now (Malaysia time) with a category (C1-C4, defaults to the worker's); once a day per worker. This is the call the future PTWH app makes for the worker it belongs to.
Clock a PTWH out now; needs a clock-in today and no clock-out yet.

get.summary: The month sheet: a row per PTWH with hours per day, workdays (1 / 0.5), open days (no clock-out), payable and pay on hold, with region / zone / station filters; voided records are left out.
get.description:
The old sheet's grid: a row per PTWH, a column per day (hours worked), workdays and payable for the month, and the same split by category.
Optional Region / Zone / Station filters (the export uses the same ones).

get.summary: Month sheet in the HR sheet's layout (month id, station, name, IC, justification, RM per day 1..31) as CSV or tab-separated text, filtered by region / zone / station; Region staff and Managers only; held or open days left blank.
get.description:
The month in the HR sheet's layout, for what the caller can see (and the Region / Zone / Station chosen). fmt=csv downloads a file; fmt=tsv is for copying
straight into the sheet. Full IC numbers are included, so Region Heads / RFS, Managers and the Superadmin only.

get.summary: Which PTWH in scope have a PTWH app login (username, on / off, last login) -- never the password.
get.description: Which PTWH in scope have an app login (username only -- never the password), so the Workers list can show it.

post.summary: Create a PTWH's app login: a username, with a generated temporary password and recovery code returned once.
post.description: Station sets the first username + password (the PTWH changes the password themselves afterwards). The password and recovery code are shown ONCE.

post.summary: Reset a PTWH's password: a new temporary password and recovery code are returned once and old sessions end.
post.description: The PTWH forgot the password and has no recovery code: the station gives a new temporary password (and a new recovery code). Old sessions end.

post.summary: Switch a PTWH's app login off or on (also ends their sessions).

get.summary: The station screen: the station's read-only location from Fleet Admin Premises (radius fixed at 100 m), the PTWH who can work there, the QR life in minutes and the PTWH app link. No QR is shown until one is requested.
get.description: The station screen: where the station is (read-only, from Premises) and the PTWH a QR code can be made for. No QR is shown until one is asked for.

post.summary: Make an emergency QR code for ONE chosen PTWH at the station: valid 10 minutes, works once, and replaces any code made before for that station. Returns the code, link and expiry.
post.description:
Make an emergency QR code for ONE PTWH at this station. It lasts QR_TTL_MIN minutes, works once, and replaces whatever QR the station asked for before.
Station staff only ask for it when that PTWH's phone location isn't working; the clock it is used for goes to Audit as 'needs review' and its pay is held.

get.summary: Clock events made in the PTWH app with how each was verified, distance from the station and whether a selfie exists, for the caller's stations (up to 2 months).
get.description: Clock events made in the PTWH app with how each was verified and the selfie -- for everyone whose scope covers the station.

get.summary: The selfie (JPEG) taken at clock in or out, for audit; only for stations in the caller's scope.

post.summary: Auditor action on a PTWH app clock event: flag it as suspicious (note required), mark it checked OK, or clear the mark. A flagged event keeps its selfies past the 14-day retention.
post.description:
An auditor (anyone whose scope covers the station) flags a clock event as suspicious, marks it checked OK, or clears the mark. Who and when are kept.
A flagged event -- and any QR (emergency) clock waiting for review -- keeps its selfies past the retention period until it is cleared or marked OK.

post.summary: PTWH app (no SSO; needs the shared X-PTWH-App-Key): log in with the username and password the station set. 5 wrong tries lock the login for 10 minutes.

get.summary: PTWH app: who is logged in, today's clock record, and whether the station's location is set (needs the PTWH's bearer token).

post.summary: PTWH app: clock in or out. Needs a phone location within 100 m of the station's Premises latitude / longitude (or, as an emergency fallback, a station QR code made for THIS PTWH within the last 10 minutes and not used yet, PLUS a reason, which puts the clock in the audit queue as needs-review) AND a base64 JPEG selfie; the server takes the time.

get.summary: PTWH app: the PTWH's own month -- days worked, hours, pay per day and the total before any back pay or deductions.
get.description: The PTWH's own month: days worked, hours, the pay for each day and the total (before any back pay / deductions).

get.summary: PTWH app: my schedule -- the next 14 days from the station's schedule, with the shift (code, label, hours) or null when nothing is scheduled.
get.description: My schedule: the next 14 days from the station's schedule (Attendance -> Schedule). Days with no shift are listed with shift = null.

post.summary: PTWH app: change your own password (needs the current one); other sessions end and a new token is returned.
PTWH app: forgot password -- the recovery code given with the login sets a new password; a fresh recovery code replaces the used one.
post.description: Forgot the password: the recovery code (given when the login was made) sets a new one, and a fresh recovery code replaces the used one.

get.summary: Attendance -> Schedule: one station's week -- every PTWH, Staff and Hybrid person with the shift on each of the 7 days, the shifts allowed per group and whether the caller may edit (Station / Region Heads and Managers only).
get.description: One station's week: every person in the three groups with the shift on each of the 7 days.

put.summary: Set (or clear) one person's shift on one day for a station; Station Heads, Region Heads, Managers and the Superadmin only, within their scope.

post.summary: Copy one week's shifts onto another for a group at a station (replaces the target week); editors only.
post.description: Copy one week's shifts onto another for a group at the station (replaces what was in the target week) -- most weeks look like the last one.

post.summary: Add a Hybrid driver, by name, to a station's schedule (stopgap until the Fleet Admin Hybrid driver list exists).

delete.summary: Take a Hybrid driver off a station's schedule and remove their scheduled days.

get.summary: Headcount per station (people posted there + TBA seats), the seats, and what the caller may do (add / remove / approve). HQ staff and above.

post.summary: Add a TBA headcount seat to a station. The HOD / Superadmin add it straight away; a Manager's seat is pending until the HOD approves it.

delete.summary: Remove a headcount seat -- no approval needed. Manager / HOD / Superadmin.
delete.description: Remove a seat -- no approval needed, for a Manager or the HOD.

post.summary: Approve a Manager's pending headcount seat. HOD / Superadmin only.
Reject (delete) a Manager's pending headcount seat. HOD / Superadmin only.

get.summary: Recovery -> PDCNR / Damage / No Label from Hub (case_type pdcnr | damage | nolabel): the rows in the caller's access, the list's field layout, and whether the caller may add rows.

post.summary: Add rows to a Recovery list (Recovery staff for PDCNR / Damage, the hub for No Label from Hub): a batch of tracking numbers with a station each; ones already open are skipped.

put.summary: Fill or correct a Recovery list row: the fields the caller is allowed to edit (station fields for station / region staff in scope, everything for Recovery).

delete.summary: Recovery / manager / admin only: delete a Recovery list row.

get.summary: Staff list for Staff & Org Chart -- every person (not the Superadmin) with position, where they are posted, what they can see (access) and whether that access was set by hand. HQ staff and above.

post.summary: Add a person to the staff list (posting = access to start with). Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.

patch.summary: Change a person's name, position or posting. Their access moves with it unless it was set by hand. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.

delete.summary: Remove a person from the staff list and the dashboard. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.

post.summary: Paste-in of many people at once for Staff & Org Chart: each row is added, or updated if the email is already in the list; one bad row never stops the others. Returns added / updated / skipped / error per row. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
post.description:
Paste-in of many people at once (the Staff & Org Chart tab parses the pasted sheet rows). One row failing never stops the
others; each row comes back as added / updated / skipped / error with the reason.

get.summary: Staff & Org Chart -- HQ staff, each region's manager, each zone's Region Head / RFS and each station's Station Head and Fleet Assistants (vacant seats show as empty), plus whether the caller can edit. HQ staff and above.
get.description:
HQ staff, then each region's manager, each zone's Region Head / RFS and each station's Station Head / Fleet Assistants --
by where they are POSTED (not by what they can see), so someone covering another station for a week still shows at home.
Stations with nobody in a role show up as vacant.

get.summary: Fleet Admin -> Premises: every station's address, size, launch date, business licence and tenancy dates (days left worked out), rent, deposit and document links; stations with no record yet come back blank. HQ staff and above.

put.summary: Create or change one station's premises record; only the fields sent are changed and an empty value clears a field. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.

post.summary: Paste-in of many stations at once for Fleet Admin -> Premises: each row is saved (only the fields it has), one bad row never stops the others; returns added / updated / error per row. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
post.description:
Paste-in of many stations at once (the tab parses the pasted sheet rows). A bad row never stops the others; fields a row leaves out
are left as they are.

get.summary: Management View -- Hub Size, Staff headcount, PTWH and parcel capacity per station plus the parcels-per-sqft setting. Managers and admins only.

put.summary: Management View -- bulk save of manager-keyed PTWH headcount and parcel capacity per station, and the parcels-per-sqft setting. Managers and admins only.
put.description:
Bulk save of the manager-keyed Capacity columns (PTWH headcount, parcel capacity) and the global parcels-per-sqft
density. Only touches those columns -- a station's mitigation / rescue plan is left as it is.

get.summary: Management View -- every station's backlog mitigation plan, rescue plan, deployment cost, status, owner and target date. Managers and admins only.

schema.title: Response List Notes Api Management View Notes Get

put.summary: Management View -- save one station's backlog mitigation plan, rescue plan, deployment cost, status, owner and target date. Managers and admins only.

get.summary: Management View -- line-haul trips (driver, station, arrival time, parcels) from the admin-uploaded Metabase 127512 file. Managers and admins only.
Lost Declared This Week (view=week) or the Summary (view=summary, optionally one week), limited to the caller's access.
get.description: Lost Declared This Week (view=week) or the Summary (view=summary, optionally one week as 2026-38 or 'all'), limited to the caller's access.

put.summary: Region staff (and managers / admins): answer for one lost declared tracking number in their access.
put.description: Region staff (and managers / admins): answer for one lost declared tracking number in their access.

post.summary: Admin only: move everything on Lost Declared This Week to the Summary now (it also happens every Monday at 22:00).
post.description: Admin only: move everything on Lost Declared This Week to the Summary now (it also happens by itself every Monday at 22:00).

get.summary: Fleet Admin -> Vehicles: every vehicle (plate, station, type, owner, driver, GDL and licence expiry with days left, fuel and TnG cards). HQ staff and above.

put.summary: Create or change one vehicle; only the fields sent are changed and an empty value clears a field. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
put.description: Change one vehicle, or add it when the plate is new.

delete.summary: Remove a vehicle from the list (it has left the fleet). Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.

post.summary: Paste-in of many vehicles at once for Fleet Admin -> Vehicles: each row is saved (only the fields it has), one bad row never stops the others. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
post.description: Paste-in of many vehicles at once (the tab parses the pasted sheet rows). A bad row never stops the others; a field a row leaves out is left as it is.

get.summary: Fleet Admin -> Assets -> Station inventory: every item of every station with good / damaged counts, per-station totals, the item groups and the standard item list. HQ staff and above.

put.summary: Add or change items of one station's inventory, or replace its whole list (replace=true). Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
put.description: Add / change items of one station (or replace its whole list). An item that exists is updated with what is sent; a new one is added.

delete.summary: Remove one item (query parameter item) from a station's inventory. Fleet Admin team and Superadmin only.
delete.description: Remove one item from a station's list (the item name is a query parameter: some contain a slash).

get.summary: Admin only: where the station list comes from (published sheet link, uploaded file or the built-in snapshot), how many stations, and what differs from the built-in list.
get.description: Admin only: where the station list comes from (sheet link / uploaded file / built-in snapshot), how many stations, what differs from the built-in one.

put.summary: Admin only: set (or clear) the published-to-the-web CSV link of the Region List sheet and read it now.
put.description: Admin only: set (or clear) the published-to-the-web CSV link of the Region List sheet, and read it now.

post.summary: Admin only: read the Region List sheet link (or the uploaded file) again now.
post.description: Admin only: read the sheet link (or the uploaded file) again now.

get.summary: KPI targets for every region (the defaults plus what an admin changed), and whether the caller may edit them.

put.summary: Admin only: set (or put back to the default) the KPI targets per region; only differences from the defaults are stored.
Admin only: switch a KPI setting -- for now whether the KPI pages count East Malaysia (default off; Retail, not Last Mile).
put.description: Admin only: switch KPI settings -- whether the KPI pages count East Malaysia and whether they count Sarawak (both default off; Retail, not Last Mile).

get.summary: Prior / Completion D0 / D3 / Terminal T7 / FIFO D0 from the uploaded Metabase feeder file: Overview (window, regions, zones, stations against their region's target) or Date trend, limited to the caller's scope.
get.description:
Prior / Completion D0 / D3 / Terminal T7 / FIFO D0 from the uploaded feeder file. The period is view (weekly / monthly / daily) + period (a week's Monday or a
month, YYYY-MM; default the last complete week / month, the current month for daily) or an explicit from..to. tab=overview: the result of the period against the one
before (or prev_from..prev_to), with the regions / zones / stations; tab=daily: the station-by-day grid of the period; tab=trend: the % per day (of the period) /
week / month (grain) for the picked regions / zones / stations. Limited to the caller's scope.

get.summary: COD RTS RCA view (Overview, Reasons, Shippers, Drivers, Timing, Parcels, Date trend) from the uploaded RTS Analysis file, limited to the caller's scope.
get.description:
The COD RTS analysis for the period (view weekly / monthly / daily + period key; default the last complete week of the file's days; a file without dates is shown whole).
tab=trend draws the days of the period (grain day) or every week / month of the file.

get.summary: The tracking numbers behind a COD RTS selection (station, reason, shipper, driver ...), capped, limited to the caller's scope.
Invalid POD RCA data -- stations, reasons and couriers by week -- from the uploaded POD validation file, limited to the caller's scope.
get.description: The Overview: per station / reason / driver for the period (view weekly / monthly / daily + period key; default the last complete week of the file's days).

get.summary: The tracking numbers behind an Invalid POD selection (station, reason, courier), limited to the caller's scope.
Every driver with invalid POD in view: attempts, invalid, invalid %, and the reasons behind it -- top reason first.
get.description: Every driver with invalid POD in view: attempts, invalid, invalid %, and the reasons behind it -- top reason first.

get.summary: Attempts and invalid POD per day for a region, zone, station or driver (level).
The weekly LM POD Performance view (zones, stations, drivers, OPS routes on the final result after the audit); managers and admins only.
Weekly KPI results by region / zone / station from the uploaded Dashboard WoW sheet, with every KPI's target (per-region targets included), limited to the caller's scope.
The uploaded OPEX result: the OPEX dashboard's own CSV gets a structured view (`opex`); any other table is shown as it is (columns + up to 5,000 rows).
get.description:
The uploaded OPEX result: the OPEX dashboard's own CSV gets a structured view (`opex`); any other table is shown as it is
(columns + up to 5,000 rows). Open to every user -- no scope filter.

get.summary: Hybrid Productivity for the KPI page (weekly, monthly or daily) from Metabase or an uploaded file, limited to the caller's scope.
get.description:
Hybrid Productivity data for the KPI Dashboard, scoped to what the viewer may see. `refresh` (admins / managers) skips the
Metabase cache. Each of the datasets comes from an uploaded file if there is one, otherwise from Metabase.

get.summary: The data-upload slots: what is uploaded in each, the Metabase link to download it from and whether the caller may upload it.
get.description: Which datasets have an uploaded file (for the KPI page's Data upload panel).

schema.title: Response Kpi Uploads Api Kpi Uploads Get

post.summary: Admin only (the Recovery lost-declared files: admins and managers): upload a CSV or Excel file into a data slot (replaces the current file).

delete.summary: Admin only (the Recovery lost-declared files: admins and managers): remove the file in a data slot.

post.summary: Several downloaded files at once: each is matched to its dataset by its columns (kd.detect_dataset) and stored exactly like the one-file upload.
post.description:
Several downloaded files at once (2026-10-03): each is matched to its dataset by its columns (kd.detect_dataset) and stored exactly like
the one-file upload. A file that can't be matched or stored is reported on its own line and never stops the others.

schema.title: Response Kpi Upload Many Api Kpi Upload Many Post

get.summary: Admin only: plain-English diagnosis of the app's Metabase connection (never returns the key).
get.description: Admins: what does Metabase say to this app's API key? (never returns the key itself)

post.summary: "Got it": quiet a follow-up / to-do / task reminder for the caller until the next slot.
post.description: "Got it": quiet this item's scheduled reminder for me until the next slot.

get.summary: The caller's Email / Gchat follow-ups (ones they created or were asked to help with).

schema.title: Response List Followups Api Followups Get

post.summary: Create a follow-up (channel, subject, contact, due date, optional helper).

patch.summary: Update a follow-up: its fields, status, or the helper's reply / acknowledgement.

post.summary: Mark the caller's follow-up replies as seen (clears the owner's unseen flag).

get.summary: The caller's To Do List items.

schema.title: Response List Todos Api Todos Get

post.summary: Add a to-do (title, details, due date, optional reminder).

patch.summary: Update a to-do: title, details, due date, progress or reminder.

get.summary: Tasks the caller assigned to others or was assigned (Task Assigned).

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api Tasks Get

post.summary: Assign a task to one or more people -- one independent row per assignee.
post.description: Assign a task to one or more people -- one row per assignee, each independent (2026-09-25).

patch.summary: Update a task: its fields, status, or the assignee's reply / acknowledgement.

post.summary: Mark the caller's task updates as seen (clears the owner's unseen flag).

get.summary: Liveness check used by the platform to confirm the backend container is up.
Return the signed-in user's identity and role/scope, derived from the SSO-injected X-Forwarded-Email header.
Return the latest station metrics snapshot, filtered to the caller's role scope, with zone and region rollups.
DoD dashboard: one Station Health snapshot per station per day for this week and last week, limited to the caller's scope.
Processing Time (staging): the last 7 days of hour-of-day timelines (shipment arrival, scan-in, 1st attempt, success, LH arrival) per station, limited to the caller's scope.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's metric count, for the UI's click-a-number drill-down. Served from an in-memory cache built by the last refresh.
get.description:
Tracking numbers behind one station's metric count, for the UI's click-to-see-TNs
panel. Served from the in-memory cache built by the last refresh -- empty right
after a restart until the next hourly (or manual) refresh runs.

get.summary: Return the latest Shipment Details snapshot (Total Fresh/Shipment, Fresh Unscan, Latlong, Fresh Attempt %, LH trip timings), scoped to the caller.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Fresh Unscan or Latlong count.
Daily KPI (staging only): today's FIFO D0, Completion D0 and Prior raw counts per station, zone and region, limited to the caller's scope. Latlong parcels excluded; resets at midnight.
Return the latest Routed View snapshot (Total Routed/Attendance/OVFD/Success/COD%/Success Rate/Completion Rate) at station/zone/region level, plus a driver-level breakdown, scoped to the caller.
Return the latest Shipper Watch snapshot (Amway/Watson/Orca hypercare, Zalora NXD, Restock NXD), scoped to the caller.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Shipper Watch metric count.
Return the latest Aging Details snapshot (station x age-bucket pivot, plus TN-level rows) for one of 5 sub-views, scoped to the caller.

Restock NXD bundles (all, or only those needing attention) per station, limited to the caller's scope.
Return the latest Old Route snapshot -- tracking numbers still stuck on their original Route ID/date (query 1451) -- at region/zone/station/driver level, scoped to the caller.

Every RDO tracking number behind one station row's count, with bundle details, uncapped, for the click-a-number modal and CSV export.
get.description:
Every tracking number behind one station row's count (all of them -- unlike
the main table this isn't capped), with the bundle details, for the click-a-number
modal and its CSV export. status: 'all' (Total TN), one of the per-status columns,
or one of the breach columns (normal/potential_breach/breach). document_type: the
same filter the station table is currently showing (empty = every type).

get.summary: Lists all submitted app feedback. Admin only.
get.description:
Admins get everyone's feedback; anyone else gets only their own. Opening the
list as the sender clears the "new reply" flag (drives the header bell).

schema.title: Response List Feedback Api Feedback Get

get.summary: Download a feedback item's attachment (its author or an admin).

patch.summary: Admin only: reply to a feedback item and / or change its status.

delete.description:
The sender removes their own feedback -- it disappears for the admins too,
whatever its status (2026-09-25 feedback), attachment included.

post.description: "Got it" on the owner reminder banner: quiet it until the next 10am / 2pm / 5pm slot.

get.summary: Dashboard users matching what is typed in the Urgent TN PIC box (2+ characters, 8 results, never the caller).
get.description:
Dashboard users matching what's typed in the Urgent TN PIC box (2026-09-25 feedback).
Any signed-in user can call it, since anyone may pick a PIC -- so it is kept narrow: 2+
characters, 8 results at most, never the caller, and only email / name / role are returned
(no scope, no last-seen).

schema.title: Response Urgent Pic Suggestions Api Urgent Tn Pic Suggestions Get

patch.summary: Update an Urgent TN row: status, note, PIC reply or acknowledgement.

delete.summary: Remove an Urgent TN row (also for its PIC).

post.summary: Remove several of the caller's own Urgent TN rows at once.
post.description:
Remove several of your own items at once (2026-09-25 feedback). Like a single remove it deletes
them for their PICs too; anything in the list that you didn't add is left alone and counted.

post.summary: Opening the Urgent TN tab: drops the NEW marker for the PIC and clears the owner's "PIC updated" flag.
post.description:
Opening the Urgent TN tab: drops the NEW marker for the PIC and clears the
owner's "PIC updated" flag. It does NOT silence the PIC's bell -- only picking
a status does (see urgent_tn_update).

get.summary: Counts behind the Urgent TN bell, the owner reminder and the Feedback badge.
get.description:
Counts behind the Urgent TN tab's bell and the Admin/Feedback badge.
urgent_notify: items assigned to me by someone else that are still in progress and
either never acknowledged or last acknowledged over an hour ago -- only between 08:00 and
20:00 Malaysia time, so nothing rings overnight.
urgent_owner_reminder: how many tracking numbers I added are still open, while the 10am / 2pm / 5pm
reminder is ringing (until I press Got it).
urgent_owner_updates: items I added where the PIC replied / changed the status.

get.summary: Admin only: who uploaded the driver / rider details CSV last, when, and how many rows.

patch.summary: Update an existing user's role, scope, or display name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Remove a user's access to the dashboard. Admin only; an admin cannot remove their own access.
